children: The EMA's CHMP recommended Zybrivo with chemotherapy for first-line treatment of eligible adults with advanced non-squamous NSCLC. The European Commission is expected to decide on authorization in the coming months.
CHMP recommends Zybrivo for first-line NSCLC
Positive EU committee opinion is a regulatory milestone, but marketing authorization still depends on the European Commission.
Phase 3 results favored sintilimab plus chemotherapy; the release gives no prior-period comparison.
Overall survival was longer in the sintilimab arm; the release gives no prior-period comparison.
The recommendation relies on a Phase 3 study; enrollment size alone does not establish commercial uptake.

This is Fortvita's first European regulatory milestone and an early step in its stated effort to bring Innovent medicines to markets outside China. A European Commission decision on marketing authorization, expected in the coming months, is the next catalyst.
